scene_description: A woman wearing an apron is standing at a gas stove in a kitchen, stirring food in a dark pan with steam rising from it. Behind her is a wicker basket filled with colorful vegetables and fruits. Kitchen utensils hang on the wall.

questions.question: What is the woman holding in her hand?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the woman is holding in her right hand.

questions.question: What is the woman doing?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the woman is doing with the pan on the stove.

questions.question: Where is the woman cooking?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the place around the woman — the stove and the kitchen behind her.

questions.question: What do we use a pan for?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the pan on the stove and think about what it is used for.

questions.question: What might the woman do when the food is ready?
questions.sentence_frame: When the food is ready, she might ___.
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the steam coming from the pan — the food is cooking. Think about what happens after cooking.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever helped cook food in the kitchen?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were in the kitchen with a grown-up.
